title: DevFest 2026 Hackathon
summary: A two-day GDG Belgrade hackathon for participants aged 18 to 26.
description: The DevFest 2026 Hackathon is a two-day in-person competition organized by GDG Belgrade. Teams of three or four participants develop and present a project; individual applicants may be matched into teams. Working language is Serbian; presentations are in English. Age, prerequisite conference attendance, and team requirements are stated in the registration instructions.

registration.instructions: Applicants must be aged 18 to 26 and attend the DevFest Conference on October 9. Teams have three or four members; individuals may apply and be matched.

unstable:participation.prerequisite: Attendance at the DevFest Conference on October 9, 2026
